answer: Unrepeatable Challenge Quarry. Each identity must answer a liveness puzzle whose seed is drawn from live environmental noise, such as quartz oscillator jitter sampled at registration. Answers are bound to that seed and cannot be replayed later or copied across identities. The dune of accumulated noise history makes each seed unique. An attacker must run a fresh physical entropy source per identity and solve within the validity window, paying real hardware and latency costs. A velvet layer of timing checks rejects batched submissions, so mass registration loses its economy of scale.
